492:                 512,
493:                 Gj[j],
494:                 G,
495:             )
496:             Gj[j] = Gj_temp
497:             sdr[j], isr[j], sir[j], sar[j] = _bss_image_crit(
498:                 s_true, e_spat, e_interf, e_artif
499:             )
500: 
501:         # return the default permutation for compatibility
502:         popt = np.arange(nsrc)
503:         return (sdr, isr, sir, sar, popt)
504: 
505: 
506: @util.deprecated(version="0.8", version_removed="0.9")
507: def bss_eval_images_framewise(
508:     reference_sources,
509:     estimated_sources,
510:     window=30 * 44100,
511:     hop=15 * 44100,
512:     compute_permutation=False,
513: ):
514:     """Framewise computation of bss_eval_images
515: 
516:     Please be aware that this function does not compute permutations (by
517:     default) on the possible relations between ``reference_sources`` and
518:     ``estimated_sources`` due to the dangers of a changing permutation.
519:     Therefore (by default), it assumes that ``reference_sources[i]``
520:     corresponds to ``estimated_sources[i]``. To enable computing permutations
521:     please set ``compute_permutation`` to be ``True`` and check that the
522:     returned ``perm`` is identical for all windows.
523: 
524:     NOTE: if ``reference_sources`` and ``estimated_sources`` would be evaluated
525:     using only a single window or are shorter than the window length, the
526:     result of ``bss_eval_images`` called on ``reference_sources`` and
527:     ``estimated_sources`` (with the ``compute_permutation`` parameter passed to
528:     ``bss_eval_images``) is returned
529: 
530:     Examples
531:     --------
532:     >>> # reference_sources[n] should be an ndarray of samples of the
533:     >>> # n'th reference source
534:     >>> # estimated_sources[n] should be the same for the n'th estimated
535:     >>> # source
536:     >>> (sdr, isr, sir, sar,
537:     ...  perm) = mir_eval.separation.bss_eval_images_framewise(
538:              reference_sources,
539:     ...      estimated_sources,
540:              window,
541:     ....     hop)
542: 
543:     Parameters
544:     ----------
545:     reference_sources : np.ndarray, shape=(nsrc, nsampl, nchan)
546:         matrix containing true sources (must have the same shape as
547:         ``estimated_sources``)
548:     estimated_sources : np.ndarray, shape=(nsrc, nsampl, nchan)
549:         matrix containing estimated sources (must have the same shape as
550:         ``reference_sources``)
551:     window : int
552:         Window length for framewise evaluation
553:     hop : int
554:         Hop size for framewise evaluation
555:     compute_permutation : bool, optional
556:         compute permutation of estimate/source combinations for all windows
557:         (False by default)
558: 
559:     Returns
560:     -------
561:     sdr : np.ndarray, shape=(nsrc, nframes)
562:         vector of Signal to Distortion Ratios (SDR)
563:     isr : np.ndarray, shape=(nsrc, nframes)
564:         vector of source Image to Spatial distortion Ratios (ISR)
565:     sir : np.ndarray, shape=(nsrc, nframes)
566:         vector of Source to Interference Ratios (SIR)
567:     sar : np.ndarray, shape=(nsrc, nframes)
568:         vector of Sources to Artifacts Ratios (SAR)
569:     perm : np.ndarray, shape=(nsrc, nframes)
570:         vector containing the best ordering of estimated sources in
571:         the mean SIR sense (estimated source number perm[j] corresponds to
572:         true source number j)
573:         Note: perm will be range(nsrc) for all windows if compute_permutation
574:         is False
575:     """
576:     # make sure the input has 3 dimensions
577:     # assuming input is in shape (nsampl) or (nsrc, nsampl)
578:     estimated_sources = np.atleast_3d(estimated_sources)
579:     reference_sources = np.atleast_3d(reference_sources)
580:     # we will ensure input doesn't have more than 3 dimensions in validate
581: 
582:     validate(reference_sources, estimated_sources)
583:     # If empty matrices were supplied, return empty lists (special case)
584:     if reference_sources.size == 0 or estimated_sources.size == 0:
585:         return np.array([]), np.array([]), np.array([]), np.array([])
586: 
587:     nsrc = reference_sources.shape[0]
588: 
589:     nwin = int(np.floor((reference_sources.shape[1] - window + hop) / hop))
590:     # if fewer than 2 windows would be evaluated, return the images result
591:     if nwin < 2:
592:         result = bss_eval_images(
593:             reference_sources, estimated_sources, compute_permutation
594:         )
595:         return [np.expand_dims(score, -1) for score in result]
596: 
597:     # compute the criteria across all windows
598:     sdr = np.empty((nsrc, nwin))
599:     isr = np.empty((nsrc, nwin))
600:     sir = np.empty((nsrc, nwin))
601:     sar = np.empty((nsrc, nwin))
602:     perm = np.empty((nsrc, nwin))
603: 
604:     # k iterates across all the windows
605:     for k in range(nwin):
606:         win_slice = slice(k * hop, k * hop + window)
607:         ref_slice = reference_sources[:, win_slice, :]
608:         est_slice = estimated_sources[:, win_slice, :]
609:         # check for a silent frame
610:         if not _any_source_silent(ref_slice) and not _any_source_silent(est_slice):
611:             sdr[:, k], isr[:, k], sir[:, k], sar[:, k], perm[:, k] = bss_eval_images(
612:                 ref_slice, est_slice, compute_permutation
613:             )
614:         else:
615:             # if we have a silent frame set results as np.nan
616:             sdr[:, k] = sir[:, k] = sar[:, k] = perm[:, k] = np.nan
617: 
618:     return sdr, isr, sir, sar, perm
619: 
620: 
621: def _bss_decomp_mtifilt(reference_sources, estimated_source, j, flen):
622:     """Decomposition of an estimated source image into four components
623:     representing respectively the true source image, spatial (or filtering)
624:     distortion, interference and artifacts, derived from the true source
625:     images using multichannel time-invariant filters.
626:     """
627:     nsampl = estimated_source.size
628:     # decomposition
629:     # true source image
630:     s_true = np.hstack((reference_sources[j], np.zeros(flen - 1)))
631:     # spatial (or filtering) distortion
632:     e_spat = (
633:         _project(reference_sources[j, np.newaxis, :], estimated_source, flen) - s_true
634:     )
635:     # interference
636:     e_interf = _project(reference_sources, estimated_source, flen) - s_true - e_spat
637:     # artifacts
638:     e_artif = -s_true - e_spat - e_interf
639:     e_artif[:nsampl] += estimated_source
640:     return (s_true, e_spat, e_interf, e_artif)
641: 
642: 
643: def _bss_decomp_mtifilt_images(
644:     reference_sources, estimated_source, j, flen, Gj=None, G=None
645: ):
646:     """Decomposition of an estimated source image into four components
647:     representing respectively the true source image, spatial (or filtering)
